OBJECT Codeunit 50100 All Rules Combined
{
  OBJECT-PROPERTIES
  {
    Date=21.11.26;
    Time=12:00:00;
    Modified=Yes;
    Version List=TEST;
  }
  PROPERTIES
  {
    OnRun=VAR
            UnusedRunVar@1000 : Integer;
            RunDate@1001 : Date;
          BEGIN
            // CAL001, CAL010, CAL020, CAL032, CAL033
            rundate:=today;
            ProcessEntries('ITEM-01',rundate);
          END;
  }
  CODE
  {
    VAR
      UnusedGlobal@1000 : Text[30];
      UsedGlobal@1001 : Integer;

    procedure ProcessEntries@1(ItemNo@1000 : Code[20];PostingDate@1001 : Date;UnusedParam@1002 : Boolean) Result : Decimal;
    var
      ItemLedgEntry@1003 : Record 32;
      UnusedLocal@1004 : Integer;
      ConfirmMsg@1005 : TextConst 'ENU=Proceed with %1?;RUS=Продолжить для %1?';
      TotalQty@1006 : Decimal;
    begin
      // CAL001, CAL002, CAL003, CAL004, CAL005, CAL010, CAL011, CAL012
      // CAL020, CAL021, CAL030, CAL031, CAL032, CAL033, CAL034
      usedglobal:=1;;


      if (itemno='') then
        exit();

      with itemledgentry do begin
        setrange("Item No.",itemno);
        setrange("Posting Date",postingdate);
        if findset then
        begin
            repeat
              totalqty:=totalqty+Quantity;
            until next=0;
        end;
      end;

      if ((totalqty>0) and
         (usedglobal>0)) then begin
        if confirm(confirmmsg,false,companyname) then
          result:=(totalqty);
      end;
    end;

    [EventSubscriber(Codeunit,80,OnAfterPostSalesDoc,'',false,false)]
    LOCAL PROCEDURE OnAfterPost@2(VAR SalesHeader@1000 : Record 36);
    BEGIN
      // CAL011: EventSubscriber warns only; CAL020: TESTFIELD has arg, FINDSET gets ()
      IF SalesHeader.FINDSET THEN
        MESSAGE('%1', SalesHeader."No.");
    END;

    BEGIN
    {
      Documentation must never be modified by rules:
      if a=b then begin end;
    }
    END.
  }
}
